Dr. Mostafa Sayed is a Lecturer at the Faculty of Computers and Artificial Intelligence, Beni-Suef University, Egypt, with over 20 years of technical experience in digital transformation and more than 10 years of academic experience in teaching and curriculum development. He holds a Ph.D. in Information Systems from Menoufia University, with research focused on adaptive frameworks for Arabic text classification using advanced machine learning techniques. Dr. Sayed has a strong background in software engineering, software testing, and project management, having worked with organizations such as the Egyptian Council of State and KHABEER Software Industries. He currently serves as program coordinator, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science, Beni Suef National University. Also, he served as the Vice Manager of the University Electronic Portal, contributing to digital transformation initiatives and system development. His research interests include artificial intelligence, natural language processing, and Arabic text classification. He has published multiple papers in international journals and conferences, reflecting his commitment to academic research and continuous professional development.

Dr. Rania Mohamed Hussien, Associate Professor of Clinical Pharmacy, Faculty of Pharmacy, Beni Suef University, with over 16 years of experience in academic administration and clinical research. Holds a BPharm (2009), MSc (2015), and PhD (2019), promoted to Assistant Professor in 2024. Currently Program Director of the PharmD Program at Beni Suef National University, with strong contributions in academic leadership, training coordination, and clinical research, including 30 peer-reviewed publications and international collaboration with the University of Florida.

DescriptionEn: Program Manager - Digital and Television Journalism
BioEn: Dr. Ahmed Shehata Abdel-Fadil is an Associate Professor and Director of the Digital & Television Journalism Program at Beni-Suef National University. He holds a Bachelor’s, Master’s, and PhD in Journalism from Cairo University. He previously managed the Quality Assurance Unit and the Media Production & Training Center. His research focuses on digital journalism, media technology, and artificial intelligence in news production. He contributed to developing updated journalism curricula aligned with digital transformation and market demands.

DescriptionEn: Program Manager - Commerce (International Accounting and Finance)
BioEn: Dr. Enas Fakhry, holds a Ph.D. in accounting from the Faculty of Commerce (English Section) at Beni Suef University. With a strong academic foundation and commitment to excellence, Dr. Enas has developed expertise not only in Accounting and Finance but also in soft skills and quality assurance, having completed specialized courses in these areas. As a Certified Trainer of Trainers (ToT), Dr. Enas is dedicated to advancing education and professional development, empowering students and colleagues alike through innovative teaching and training methods. Currently, Dr. Enas serves as the Program Manager of the International Accounting and Finance Program at Beni Suef National University, where they oversee curriculum design, program quality, and student success. Dr. Enas combines academic rigor with practical leadership, striving to prepare graduates for the challenges of global finance and accounting while fostering a culture of continuous improvement and professional growth.

Prof. Dr. Nabil A. Hasona is working as a coordinator of Biochemistry- Microbiology program at BSNU and Professor of Biochemistry at Faculty of Science, Beni-Suef University , Egypt. He is involved in multidisciplinary research to decipher real life problems from the environment to human diseases. Prof. Nabil’s main research area includes biochemistry, enzymology, biomolecules, molecular biology, human diseases as well as microbiological and biotechnological approaches in these areas. He has published more than 50 research articles in reputed international journals. Used to teach basic and clinical science hybrid curriculum that include systems-based active learning strategies such a PBL and TBL. Excellent outcome based teaching and research skills to higher education sector that includes administrative ability as well as training skill. Eager to join any prestigious institution for challenging education.

BioEn: Dr. Mohamed Murad, PhD in Environmental Technology (LUT, Finland, 2015), is an expert in hydrology, water quality, and environmental geochemistry. He teaches and supervises graduate students at Beni-Suef University and has collaborated with multiple international institutions. He has contributed to research on Lake Qarun, wastewater treatment, and global river systems, published in high-impact journals, and consulted on the EU-funded Fayoum Wastewater Expansion Programme. He is also active in science communication and sustainable water management initiatives.

Dr. Nesma Ahmed Helmy Ahmed is a Lecturer at the Department of Basic Sciences, Faculty of Physical Therapy, Beni-Suef University, and the Academic Coordinator of the Physical Therapy Program at Beni-Suef National University (BSNU). She obtained her Bachelor's degree in Physical Therapy in 2005 with Very Good with Honors, followed by a Master's degree in Basic Sciences in 2011, and a Ph.D. in Physical Therapy in 2015 with a Very Good grade. Her research focused on postural analysis and the impact of therapeutic interventions on musculoskeletal disorders. She has extensive academic and teaching experience, having taught several courses including Electrotherapy, Hydrotherapy, Therapeutic Exercises, and Measurement & Evaluation at both Beni-Suef University and Delta University. She has also contributed to the development of the educational process through the implementation of modern teaching strategies and e-learning. Dr. Nesma has held several academic and administrative positions, including Academic Coordinator, E-learning Coordinator, and Head of Examination Control Units, in addition to her membership in quality assurance and research ethics committees and her active participation in accreditation activities. Her research interests focus on rehabilitation, musculoskeletal disorders, and the effectiveness of modern therapeutic techniques. She has published several research papers in reputable international journals and has participated in numerous national and international conferences.

Professor of Pediatric Nursing and Dean of the Faculty of Nursing (Program Director) at Beni-Suef National University, and Vice Dean for Education and Students' Affairs at the Faculty of Nursing, Beni-Suef University, Egypt.

She holds a PhD in Nursing Sciences (Pediatric and Neonatal Nursing) from Ain Shams University. Prof. Elmwafie has extensive academic and administrative experience in pediatric nursing, quality assurance, accreditation, and curriculum development. She has held several leadership positions in Egyptian universities and served as an Assistant Professor at Al Jouf University, Saudi Arabia.

Her scholarly work includes numerous publications in nationally and internationally indexed journals (Q1–Q3), active participation and leadership in scientific conferences, and supervision of Master's and PhD theses. Her research interests focus on child health, pediatric nursing care, healthcare quality, patient safety, and evidence-based nursing interventions.

Prof. Dr. Abeer Enayatallah Abdel Fattah is an Assistant Professor of Physical Chemistry at the Faculty of Science, Beni Suef University. She earned her Ph.D. through a joint supervision scholarship between Beni Suef University and the National Institute for Materials Science (NIMS) in Tsukuba, Japan. She currently serves as the Director of the Applied Industrial Chemistry Program. She has distinguished academic and research expertise in industrial chemistry and its practical applications across various production sectors. She has contributed to the development and modernization of the program’s curricula in line with accredited academic standards and labor market needs, with a strong focus on applied aspects and integrating theoretical knowledge with practical training. She is committed to promoting applied scientific research principles among students from early stages, enhancing their practical skills, and encouraging innovation and teamwork. She aims to prepare graduates who are academically and professionally qualified, capable of competing effectively, and contributing to the development of chemical industries and community service.

JobTitle: Vice President of the University for Academic Affairs
BioEn: Prof. Rasha Mohamed Tawfiq serves as Vice President for Academic Affairs at Beni Suef National University, with extensive experience in higher education, quality assurance, and academic program development. Former Vice Dean of the Faculty of Sport Sciences for Education and Student Affairs (2019–2026), contributing to the advancement of academic and student services. Member of the Scientific Production Review Committee for faculty promotions (Cycle 14, 2022–2025) in the field of School Sports. Director of the Quality Assurance Unit, Faculty of Sport Sciences – Beni Suef University (2016–2021), leading accreditation and institutional performance improvement. Executive Director of the Support and Development of Educational Effectiveness Project (SDEE – Cycle 3), funded by the Ministry of Higher Education. Broad expertise in academic supervision, program development, quality systems, and digital transformation in higher education. Holder of professional diplomas and advanced training in strategic leadership, crisis management, quality assurance, e-learning, international publishing, human resources, NLP, and statistical analysis. Message from the Vice President for Academic Affairs Welcome to Beni Suef National University, where students are at the heart of our educational mission. We are committed to developing modern academic programs that align with scientific progress and labor market needs. Our academic affairs strive to build a flexible, quality-driven learning system that integrates theory with practice, ensuring an outstanding educational experience and clear academic pathways for students. We continuously update curricula, support faculty members, and apply fair and transparent evaluation systems to prepare graduates with knowledge, skills, and lifelong learning abilities, ready to compete locally and internationally. We look forward to making your academic journey with us a path of success and distinction. Prof. Rasha Mohamed Tawfiq Vice President for Academic Affairs.

JobTitle: Vice President of the University for International Relations
BioEn:
Welcome to Beni Suef National University, where academic excellence meets regional and international engagement. Here, we create opportunities through a modern learning environment and distinguished international partnerships.

At Beni Suef National University, we believe that education is a comprehensive scientific experience that includes cultural interaction, exchange of expertise, and the development of the student's academic and professional character.

The International Relations Department plays a significant role in enhancing the university's regional and international presence and expanding its network of cooperation with regional and international universities and institutions.

We continue our journey to solidify the university's position as a globally-minded educational institution that contributes to preparing graduates capable of interacting with diverse cultures and contributing to building a bright future.

Dear students, we welcome you to Beni Suef National University. We are honored by your choice. At our university, you will find a supportive learning environment that values diversity and encourages creativity. We offer diverse academic programs and an internationally experienced faculty. We are committed to accompanying you every step of your university journey and providing a rich educational experience that opens wide horizons of knowledge and professional success. Our goal is to prepare you to become the leaders of tomorrow.

We emphasize that openness to the world is the foundation of development and innovation. Therefore, we strive to provide academic partnerships with distinguished universities and research centers regionally and internationally. These partnerships offer exceptional opportunities for students and faculty members to participate in exchange programs, joint study opportunities, and collaborative research that aligns with the latest international standards. We also organize and participate in international conferences.

We are committed to providing comprehensive support to our international students from the moment they enroll until their graduation, ensuring a distinguished and inspiring university experience.

We welcome all our Egyptian and international students and invite you to discover the high-quality education, creative university life, and genuine opportunities for shaping your future that the university offers.

We look forward to welcoming you to the campus of Beni Suef National University and partnering with you to achieve your aspirations and build your future.

Vice president for international relations
Prof. Enas Yahia

JobTitle: Head of the Education and Student Affairs Sector
BioEn:
Dear students and applicants,
Beni Suef National University thanks you for your trust and offers high-quality education through three main sectors: Health Sciences, Engineering and Applied Sciences, and Humanities, all based on a credit-hour system.

The university continuously develops its programs to meet labor market needs, with teaching delivered by experienced professors.

Three key messages:

Choose your field of study carefully based on proper research, not pressure.
Understand your rights and responsibilities to benefit fully and avoid issues.
Use your time wisely to achieve your goals.

Wishing you all success.
